description: This file defines the LegacyContextEngine class, implementing the ContextEngine interface for backward compatibility in a context management system. It mainly provides no-op or pass-through implementations for ingestion, assembly, session management, and delegates compacting to an external runtime function. Also includes a registration function for this legacy engine.

classes.name: LegacyContextEngine
classes.description: Implements the ContextEngine interface, providing legacy behavior for context management, including no-op methods for ingest and afterTurn, pass-through assemble, and delegating compact to an external runtime.
